documents.title: Refill
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Need refills on metformin and levothyroxine please. Also can the powder go through insurance as a prescription? Buying it at the store adds up.

documents.title: Refills
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Metformin and levothyroxine 90-day x 3 sent. Polyethylene glycol 3350 prescription sent; pharmacy reports plan doesn't cover it, OTC store brand is cheaper - pt informed and fine with that.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Diabetes Follow-up
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Routine DM. Feels well. Post-rectopexy no recurrence, bowels regular on daily polyethylene glycol. Bladder: rare urgency, does her exercises "when I remember."
Metformin, levo, PEG, MVI.
Exam: weight stable, BP fine. Heart, lungs normal. Feet: monofilament intact, pulses intact.
A1c, BMP. Shingrix after her 50th birthday next month - will do at the pharmacy.
Physical Sept.

documents.title: Outside immunization
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Shingrix #1 4/29/25 per pharmacy notification. Dose 2 due 2-6 months.

documents.title: Diabetic eye examination
documents.author: optometry
documents.body: Dilated eye exam 07/17/2025: no diabetic retinopathy either eye, maculae normal. New glasses prescribed. Recheck 12 months.

reports.text: Liquid-based cytology. Satisfactory for evaluation, endocervical/transformation zone component present. Negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy. High-risk HPV not detected.
reports.conclusion: NILM; HPV negative. Routine screening interval.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam, 50F.
Year in review: rectopexy Oct 2024, no recurrence. Colonoscopy normal 9/2024 (next 2034). Bladder mostly controlled. Shingrix complete. Eye exam July, no retinopathy.
No RUQ pain since 2023; gallstones still in place, she's aware.
Meds: metformin 1000 BID, levothyroxine 100 mcg, polyethylene glycol 17 g daily, multivitamin, ibuprofen now and then.
ROS negative.
Exam: NAD. Thyroid normal. Heart RRR, no murmurs. Lungs clear. Abd soft, healed port scars, NT, no organomegaly. Breasts without masses. Pelvic: normal external, cervix normal, Pap/HPV collected. Feet intact sensation and pulses.
PHQ-9 2, GAD-7 2.
Plan: labs as above; Pap/HPV; mammogram due (last Nov 2023) - ordered. Flu/COVID at nurse clinic next month. RTC 6 mo.

documents.title: Immunizations
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Flu IM left deltoid, 2025-26 Moderna COVID IM right deltoid. Pt tolerated both, monitored per protocol.

reports.text: Bilateral screening mammography with tomosynthesis. Comparison 2023, 2022, 2020. Breast density: scattered fibroglandular. No dominant mass, suspicious calcification or distortion in either breast. No change.

documents.title: Text with patient
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Texted a photo - eyes look yellow. Says she's been itchy for about two months (thought it was dry winter skin), stools pale, urine dark like tea, and a full feeling under the right ribs. Not really painful. No fever. With her known gallstones this needs labs and imaging today, not something I can get done quickly enough in the office during school break. Advised ED in the morning, sooner if fever, pain or vomiting. She'll go first thing.
